h1: Pipe benders and tube bending machines — CNC, NC, all-electric and hydraulic, Ø15/32″ to Ø8-5/8″
intro: A pipe bender or tube bending machine draws a tube around a bend die to a set angle; a mandrel bender adds an internal mandrel so thin-wall tube bends to a tight radius without wrinkling or collapsing. NovoTech sells two lines of mandrel benders in Canada, each on its own pages: ISITAN, built in Turkey since 1959 — servo CNC mandrel benders with 3D simulation, NC hydraulic mandrel benders with a 10″ touchscreen, compact SFB 32 and aluminum-profile benders, and BK rotary draw benders for pipe, bar and box section, with the premium-line SPB NC draw benders and Tubend's TB 34 and TB 42 mandrel-less pipe benders beside them; and CSM, built in Taiwan since 1982 — all-electric EMB / EMR benders that bend left- and right-hand in one part, MBE / MRE and T-series electric hybrids with stacked tools, TSR / TDR hydraulic CNC and TNCB NC pipe benders to Ø8-5/8″ and two-head symmetric benders. From a 1 HP bench bender for 1-1/4″ pipe to a 20 ft hydraulic CNC pipe bender for shipyard pipe, every machine is supplied with a CSA-approved panel, tooling and installation, and supported from Mississauga, ON. Below, each page in brief and every model in one capacity table.

range_note: Tube capacities are for mild steel; stainless, aluminum, bar and box-section capacities for the BK series are on the rotary draw page. CLR = centreline radius (the largest die radius). Working length is the maximum feed with the standard mandrel rod (extended mandrels to 20 ft are optional on SFB models); for the CSM symmetric benders it is the span between the two bends. Weights for the CSM benders are quoted with the configuration.

faq.q: Pipe bender, tube bender, mandrel bender — what is the difference?
faq.a: "Pipe" is sized by nominal pipe size (NPS) and schedule, "tube" by outside diameter and wall, but the machines are the same: a bend die, a clamp and a pressure die draw the material around the radius. A mandrel bender adds an internal mandrel so thin-wall tube can be bent to a tight radius without wrinkling; our SFB benders are mandrel benders, the BK series are rotary draw benders without a mandrel. Every capacity on these pages is given as OD × wall in inches and gauge.

faq.q: How do I choose a tube bender?
faq.a: Start with the largest tube (OD × wall and material), the tightest centreline radius and the number of bends per part — that sets mandrel or not and the model size. Then the volume: a rotary draw BK for occasional bends, an SFB NC for programmed angles with manual feed, the NC/C carrier for repeatable multi-plane parts, and a CNC when parts come from a drawing in hundreds. Send us a part drawing and we will size the machine and tooling.

faq.q: Which tube benders does NovoTech stock?
faq.a: We keep the SFB 38-NC and 51-NC and the BK-050 in Mississauga, ON, and bring CNC models, carrier models and the larger 76 and 90 sizes in to order with their tooling. In-stock machines carry the 7-day money-back guarantee. CSM benders are quoted with the tooling for your part drawings.

Both are mandrel benders, installed and supported by the same NovoTech technicians. ISITAN (Turkey) covers Ø1-1/4″ to Ø3-1/2″ with NC, carrier and CNC models — the job-shop and fabricator range, several models in stock. CSM (Taiwan) covers Ø15/32″ brake line to Ø8-5/8″ pipe with all-electric and electric-hybrid CNC benders, stacked tools, rear boosters, hydraulic CNC and NC pipe benders and automation — the series-production range. Send us the part drawing and we quote from either line.

faq.q: Do you install tube benders and train operators?
faq.a: Yes — our technicians commission the bender anywhere in Canada, set up the first tooling, prove out your part and train operators on the NC or CNC. Remote assistance over the network is built into the CNC models, and we support every machine by video call.

faq.q: What do you need from me to quote tooling?
faq.a: Six things: material type, tube or profile size, wall thickness, the smallest centreline radius (CLR) you bend, the maximum bend angle and the maximum tube length. Every bender comes with one die set in the size you request; extra sets, ball mandrels and wiper dies are quoted from the same list.

faq.q: What voltage do the benders run on?
faq.a: Three-phase machines are supplied for 600 V as standard with a CSA-approved panel; 208 V, 240 V and 480 V 3-phase are available on request, and 240 V single-phase on the BK-42 and other models with a small enough motor.
